name: Nightsong Woods
summary: In eastern Ashenvale, Nightsong Woods runs from Raynewood Retreat toward Azshara. Night elves and the Warsong clan fight over the forest as the Horde harvests lumber, while demonic corruption lingers among its groves.

sections.title: A Forest Carved by War
sections.body: Nightsong Woods is Ashenvale’s eastern battleground. The Falfarren River cuts through its western reaches, marking a tense boundary between Alliance settlements and Horde incursions. Farther east, Splintertree Post directs Horde campaigns against the Silverwing Sentinels. Warsong orcs fell the southern groves for lumber to fuel the Horde’s expansion, angering the Kaldorei. Satyr strongholds at Satyrnaar and Xavian, along with demonic remnants at Demon Fall Canyon and Felfire Hill, taint the eastern forest.

faq.q: Where are the Nightsong Woods located?
faq.answer: Nightsong Woods covers eastern Ashenvale, from Raynewood Retreat and the northern road to Felwood toward Azshara’s untamed border.

faq.q: Why is there so much fighting in this part of Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Silverwing Sentinels and the Warsong clan fight over this frontier. The Horde depends on dense timber from the southern trees to build and sustain its settlements, while night elves battle to halt the cutting and reclaim their ancestral land.

No single faction controls Nightsong Woods. The Falfarren River roughly divides western Alliance territory from eastern Horde positions at Splintertree Post and the Warsong Lumber Camp. Corrupt satyr hold parts of the woodland at Satyrnaar and Xavian, while Legion forces are near Demon Fall Canyon.

Demonic forces and corruption threaten the eastern wilderness. Satyr dwell in fortified ancient ruins at Satyrnaar and Xavian, while lingering Burning Legion fiends inhabit Felfire Hill and the depths of Demon Fall Canyon.

angles.text: As a night elf, you face a sacred borderland under siege. Defending its ancient groves from Warsong axes and purging lingering satyr corruption are matters of duty for the Kaldorei.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure vital building timber and strategic supply lanes through Splintertree Post. Sentinel ambushes and demonic beasts threaten this eastern front.
